sources.quote: HD 104985, formally named Tonatiuh, is a solitary star with an exoplanetary companion in the northern constellation of Camelopardalis.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 10.8 solar radii and 3.00 solar masses (FLAME) and 4,943 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
